subject: Myth & Symbolism
title: Animals We No Longer See
description: A 60-second lesson on Animals We No Longer See.

hook.text: Lions once roamed Europe. Ireland once had wolves. The animals that shaped our myths are mostly gone.

buildup.text: Cave bears inspired bear cults. Aurochs inspired bull worship. As species vanished, only the symbols remained.

discovery.text: England's lion symbol persists even though wild lions have been extinct there for over 10,000 years.

twist.text: We now protect animals we once hunted. Wolves return to Yellowstone. The mythic beast gets a second chapter.

climax.text: Animal symbolism outlasts the animals. The myths remember what the forests have forgotten.

punchline.text: The animal dies. The symbol survives.

quiz.question: Why do some national symbols feature animals that no longer live in those countries?
options: The myths and symbols outlasted the actual animals
